decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans numbered 1486/11/01, 1486/11/02,  site location plan and site outline plan design and access statement receive 19th September 2011 submitted  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those shown on the approved plans.
description: Internal and external alterations to the existing building comprising of the removal of some internal partitions; installation of new windows, new blue fascia, refurbishment of the existing doors and cleaning of brick work
